page_title: RSO 0-2 RMA | Real Sociedad v Real Madrid 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Juan Martinez Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+4' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Alex Remiro was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Endrick (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.

89' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
87' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

86' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
85' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
84' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to discuss the decision with Juan Martinez Munuera, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
82' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' The linesman signals that Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
79' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) replaces Javi Lopez.
77' Substitution. Arda Guler makes way for Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
75' Luka Sucic will be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is coming onto the pitch as Nayef Aguerd cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Remiro into left side of the goal.
74' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
74' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Real Madrid!
73' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Madrid. Let’s see what happens!
72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
70' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

70' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Thibaut Courtois keeps the ball out.
69' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded the free kick.
64' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
63' Umar Sadiq goes off the pitch and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) comes on.
63' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Sheraldo Becker and he is replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
62' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Umar Sadiq, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
58' 0 - 1 Goal! Alex Remiro gets a hand on the penalty from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
58' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
58' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) handles the ball inside the penalty area. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Real Madrid.
57' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
57' One of the Real Sociedad players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. Real Madrid have a free kick.
55' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
52' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
52' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
50' The attendance for today's match is 37370.
50' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
49' Juan Martinez Munuera blows the whistle, Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
46' A great pass puts Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
46' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
45+1' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.
45+1' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
45+1' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
44' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
41' It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.

40' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
38' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
36' OFF THE BAR! Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
36' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
36' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
36' The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
31' The linesman raises his flag. Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
30' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

29' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left side of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off a decent save to deny him. Real Madrid have a corner.
28' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
25' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
25' Carlo Ancelotti is forced to make a change. Brahim Diaz is unable to continue due to injury, Rodrygo (Real Madrid) comes on.
18' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
17' Juan Martinez Munuera shows the yellow card to Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
13' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
9' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

8' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
7' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
7' A pass from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Alex Remiro and the move breaks down.
6' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

3' Thibaut Courtois reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) towards the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Real Sociedad win a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
